regions.today: A wet start with spells of rain, heavy at times, but gradually easing. The rain will clear to the northeast through the afternoon, with some bright spells following. Highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees in moderate to fresh southeasterly winds, becoming moderate westerly as the rain clears.
regions.tonight: Generally cloudy but dry tonight, with a few clearer breaks at times. A few scattered outbreaks of rain and drizzle will feed in from the west towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 8 to 11 degrees in moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Another cloudy in day instore with rain and drizzle becoming more persistent through the morning, with heavy falls at times. Highest temperatures of 13 to 18 degrees in moderate to fresh southwest winds.
